Overview
Liberty Military Housing – Own your passion forservice!

About Liberty Military Housing

Liberty Military Housing is one of the largest providers of military family housing in the United States. In partnership with theUS military, we are committed to delivering safe,high-qualityhomes and exceptional service to thefamilies ofmen and women who serve our country.We’reseeking dedicated team members for a variety of roles and offer excellent benefits, training, development, and opportunities for advancement. Ifyou’reready to grow your career and become anemployee owner, explore our currentopportunitiestoday.

**What We Provide You:**

Liberty Military Housing is committed to supporting our team members in every aspect of life—from career development to family needs and overall health and wellness. We proudly offer a comprehensive and competitive benefitsand incentivepackage that includes:

Platinum-Level Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage with affordable premiums

Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) become anemployee ownerwith retirement savings

401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match

Education Reimbursement up to $5,250 per year

Generous Paid Time Off , including vacation, sick time, and 10 paid holidays

Wellness Benefits ,including free gym access andadditionalwellness programs

Quarterly & Monthly Bonus Incentives

Career Growth Opportunities, Unlock your potential with immersive,hands-ontraining designed to elevate your skills, help you advance, and build a rewardinglong-termcareer with a company that truly invests in your future

Life and AD&D Insurance

Responsibilities
**A Day in the Life of a Bookkeeper:**

As a Liberty Military Housing Bookkeeper, you will maintain and manage the day-to-day bookkeeping operations of a multi-family residential community. Your role includes various accounting tasks, vendor and customer service follow up and other administrative functions. Your role requires accuracy, effective customer service, the ability to work efficiently and effectively to deliver on our mission of providing exemplary service in accordance with Liberty Military Housing’s quality customer satisfaction standards.

**Your Responsibilities include, but not limited to:**

Directly responsible for the bookkeeping activities of the community, including paying bills, creating and receiving purchase orders, change orders, processing of A/P, A/R, delinquencies, collections, and invoicing.

Assisting the District Manager with the community budget and achievement of operational and financial goals.

Responsible for the collection of outstanding rents, prepares and sends delinquency and balance due letters to residents.

Maintaining accurate records of all bookkeeping transactions; adjusts ledgers, prepares/reconciles delinquency reports, verifies/adjusts BAH, and submits write-off packages.

Assists with the preparation of monthly financial accounting reports and explanation of budget variances.

Assists with the auditing and processing of move outs, transfers, etc.; ensuring accuracy and timely input.

Vendor/contractor communications concerning billing and invoicing.

Participates in outreach marketing activities (i.e. market surveys, shop competitors) on a regular basis to obtain prospective residents.

Assists incoming residents/potential residents with housing and community information.

Assists other office staff with duties and customer relations.

Performs other general office duties, i.e. phones, filing, special projects and assignments, as needed.

May participate in property walks/inspections (grounds, common areas, parking lots, community rooms, make-readies, quality control, etc.) to ensure community is well maintained according to LMH’s quality standards.

Participates in and attends various department or regional meetings, resident functions, seminars, training and work-related events.

Qualifications
**What You Need for Success:**

Position requires 1 or more years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Proficiency in personal computer skills, keyboard, Internetsearch, email correspondence, math, Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and other software applications preferred (i.e. Yardi, Payscan).

Effective communication and interaction with management team, military partners, co-workers, vendors or residents; sufficient to exchange or convey information and to give and receive work direction.

Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.

Ability to multi-task, prioritize and complete assigned duties to ensure operational objectives are achieved.

Must possess a positive and professional demeanor in all interactions, under all circumstances.

Must possess a valid driver's license.

Ability to operate a company or personal vehicle or electrical cart.

Must be available to work a flexible schedule, including weekends, off-hours and emergencies as required.

Ability to travel to other regional locations for work, training, meetings and other work-related activities.

Pay Range: $22.00 - $24.25 (hourly)

Span Construction & Engineering, Inc. is a pioneer in the pre-engineered metal building erection industry, proudly operating as a 100% employee-owned company (ESOP) in the building industry. Since our inception in 1980, we’ve fostered enduring relationships as trusted advisors with our valued clients. We are the number one builder in our field. We are dedicated to providing exceptional engineering and construction services, having successfully completed over 214 million square feet of buildings to date, with ongoing projects 24/6 throughout the year.

Setting the industry standard, we prioritize safety, quality, and integrity in all our endeavors. We are inspired, challenged, and empowered to be and give our best every day, not only because we are each exceptional at what we do, but also because we are surrounded by hungry, humble, and smart people.

**About Our Payroll Administrator Role:**
As a Payroll Administrator, you'll be responsible for all tasks involved in processing payroll. The Payroll Administrator has a range of duties that include collecting timesheets, calculating wages, and ensuring employees receive their pay on time.

Some of the things you will do as a Payroll Administrator:

Collect timesheet data and payroll information.

Enter data into payroll and administrative databases and software programs.

Calculate wages, benefits, tax deductions, commissions, etc.

Prepare and process paychecks and cash deposits.

Maintain accurate records of payroll documentation and transactions.

Respond to payroll-related inquiries and resolving concerns.

Perform account balance and payroll reconciliations.

Prepare financial reports for accounting and auditing purposes.

Prepare periodic payroll reports for review by management.

Monitor and track PTO accrual.

Monitor new hire paperwork.

Sort, disburse, and mail employee checks.

Perform other tasks as deemed necessary.

**Some of the Things We’re Looking For:**

3 years of experience processing payroll, preferably with experience in processing the payroll of over 200 employees weekly and with job costing

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365 products, utilizing a PC, mobile devices, and company communication tools (e.g., email, internet, chat, etc.)

This position requires the ability to communicate effectively in English and Spanish to perform job-related duties

Participation in our ESOP program

401K

Vacation

Position Status: Full-Time

Location: Madera, CA

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, with overtime as required.

**Physical Requirements:**

The ability to remain in a stationary position, often sitting for prolonged periods.

Manual dexterity needed to operate a computer and other office equipment.

Occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

Primarily based in an office setting with a controlled climate.

Villara Building Systems

Build your dreams… and join in building dreams for others. Join a team-centered, highly respected Sacramento-based company and make a difference for families all over Northern California.
Villara is the largest residential mechanical contractor in California. That means that we design, construct, maintain, service, and replace some of the most important systems in homes and apartments—HVAC, plumbing, and solar. Imagine the difference between a home or apartment that has great HVAC and one that has so-so or non-functioning HVAC. Imagine the difference between a home or apartment that has great plumbing and one that has so-so- or non-functioning plumbing. Imagine being a key member of a team that makes this difference for tens of thousands and hundreds of thousands of singles, couples, and families all throughout Northern California. Now imagine doing this with a team of great, delightful, committed colleagues, many who choose to spend the rest of their career as part of the Villara team.
We are seeking a detail-oriented and dependable Payroll Specialist to assist with weekly payroll processing of 600 – 800 employees. Dayforce experience is a huge plus as well as previous experience in construction and high volume payroll.
Technical Responsibilities of the Job The essential functions and responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to the following:
Maintain thorough knowledge of MyVillara, SAP CATS, and Dayforce Payroll; use each of these systems on a daily or weekly basis to deliver timely, accurate payrolls.
Review time entries for reasonableness. Identify potential errors and anomalies and advise relevant team members (Payroll Lead, Business Operations Manager, and the employee’s superintendent and manager, as appropriate) for prompt correction of those errors and anomalies.
Upload and transfer time between MyVillara, SAP, and Dayforce. Enter time manually when necessary.
Enter additional forms of compensation, including commissions, auto allowances, and additional pay types. Review time records for missed or incorrect meal period compliance.
Review and approve employee withholding and direct deposit forms and related documentation.
Analyze draft payroll results, including gross pay, benefit deductions, tax withholding, and garnishments for reasonableness. Research and resolve all discrepancies, anomalies, and errors or immediately elevate to Payroll Department Lead if unable to promptly resolve.
Apply knowledge of multi-state wage and hour laws for all states in which Villara employees work to accurately validate overtime and double time calculations. Immediately advise the Payroll Department Lead of any identified errors
Calculate all items required for accurate final pay related to employee separations.
Process manual checks (e.g. adjustments, final checks, etc.) as required
Generate and analyze Dayforce Payroll reports to support payroll operations and management requests.
Respond promptly to employee, supervisor, and manager payroll-related inquiries. Resolve employee issues where possible.
Support department and company-wide audits as requested.
Maintain all time and payroll records, reports, and documentation in accordance with Villara and regulatory requirements.
Utilize Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Excel, and Word effectively in daily work.
Utilize solid mathematics skills and good number sense—able to identify when a number or calculation in clearly or likely incorrect.
Actively engage in training, coaching and professional development opportunities, incorporating feedback to improve performance.
Education and Experience Minimum of 3 years previous experience in Payroll
High School Diploma or equivalent
College education is a plus
Excel experience is required.
Previous experience with Dayforce is a plus.
General knowledge of accounting practices.
Ability to multi-task and handle a large volume payroll.
Previous construction experience is preferred but not mandatory.
Bilingual English/Spanish is very positive.

Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We are seeking a highly organized, collaborative, and proactive Real Estate Project Coordinator to support the planning, execution, and day-to-day management of commercial real estate projects and portfolio operations. You'll serve as an essential fulcrum on commercial real estate construction projects, workplace and real estate portfolio expansion, supporting a team of Real Estate Project Managers. You’ll report to the Senior Director, Global Real Estate and work from our Santa Ana, CA office headquarters. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. Leverage AI to ideate creatively on ways to improve Real Estate team reporting, project modeling and other project management processes

Proficiency with Google Suite, and project management tools
Experience with lease administration systems, construction project management technology or real estate software is a plus
Passionate about the collectibles industry, manufacturing environments and process improvements

Approved-Freight-Forwarders

City of Industry Office
City of Industry, CA 91746, USA

Description On Site, M-F, Full Time
About Us:
Founded in 1927, the DeWitt Companies is a family-owned group of transportation businesses with a strong presence in Hawaii, Guam, and California. We provide moving, storage, trucking, freight, and logistics services, helping individuals, businesses, and government customers move goods safely and efficiently. For nearly a century, our companies have built a reputation for dependable service, local expertise, and long-term relationships.
Operational Leadership Manage all day-to-day warehouse, freight forwarding, and 3PL operations.
Oversee inbound, outbound, consolidation and deconsolidation services, cross-dock, transloading, pick & pack, storage, and distribution activities.
Ensure all customer shipments are processed accurately and shipped on time.
Establish daily operational priorities while balancing labor, equipment, and customer demands.
Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WI’s) to standardize operations across departments.
Lead daily operational meetings and communicate performance expectations.
Manage consolidation shipments via ocean, truckload (FTL), LTL, drayage, and intermodal transportation.
Coordinate Hawaii and island shipments while ensuring all documentation is complete and accurate.
Oversee shipment planning, booking, routing, cargo visibility, and exception management.
Build and maintain relationships with steamship lines, trucking companies
Monitor service failures and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
Warehouse & 3PL Operations Oversee receiving, inventory control, put-away, replenishment, order fulfillment, staging, shipping, and cycle counting.
Maintain inventory accuracy through routine audits and inventory reconciliation.
Optimize warehouse space utilization and improve operational flow.
Ensure proper handling of customer inventory and value-added services.
Support new customer implementations and operational start-ups.
Systems & Technology Utilize Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), RF scanning technology, and transportation systems to maximize efficiency.
Ensure operational data integrity within a WMS.
Partner with IT and leadership to implement automation and technology improvements.
Develop operational dashboards and KPI reporting.
Financial & Performance Management Manage labor scheduling to meet productivity goals while controlling costs.
Monitor departmental budgets and operational expenses.
Improve profitability through process improvements and waste reduction.
Ensure billing accuracy and timely completion of operational transactions.
Identify opportunities to increase revenue through operational efficiencies and value-added services.
Leadership & Employee Development Lead, coach, mentor, and develop supervisors, team leads, and operations personnel.
Conduct performance evaluations and establish employee development plans.
Create accountability through measurable performance metrics.
Support hiring, onboarding, succession planning, and employee engagement initiatives.
Foster a culture centered around teamwork, accountability, customer service, and continuous improvement.
Customer Experience Serve as the operational point of contact for key customer accounts.
Participate in customer business reviews and operational meetings.
Resolve service issues and customer escalations with urgency.
Partner with Sales and Business Development to support customer growth opportunities.
Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with OSHA, TSA, Hazmat, and company policies.
Promote a proactive safety culture through regular inspections, audits, and employee training.
Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.
Maintain warehouse security and inventory integrity.
Qualifications 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in freight forwarding, warehouse operations, or third-party logistics (3PL).
Minimum of 5 years managing supervisors and multiple operational departments.
Strong understanding of domestic and freight forwarding.
Experience with ocean, air freight, drayage, intermodal, LTL, FTL, and distribution operations.
Working knowledge of import/export documentation and customs compliance.
Transportation Management Systems (TMS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and Microsoft Office Suite.
Strong analytical, financial, and operational planning skills.
Proven ability to lead change and build high-performing teams.

### Job Description

Job Description

ACRC is seeking Service Coordinators!!

We are hiring in the following units!

\- Residential unit

\- Adult unit

\- Children’s unit

\- Early Intervention unit

The Service Coordinator provides case management and advocacy for persons with developmental disabilities. This position is currently located in the Sacramento office on a HYBRID schedule. Typical duties include assisting clients and their families in acquiring and maintaining assessed supports and services including transportation, vocational training, day programming, education, mental health services, medical care, and independent living training; Responsibilities include participation in the development of the Individual Program Plan (IPP); monitoring the IPP and assisting with revisions as necessary; assisting clients and their families in acquiring and maintaining assessed supports and services; serving as an advocate for the client with community agencies; consulting with and assisting vendors with certifications, applications, and referrals; participation in the development of Individual Program Plans for clients; monitoring these plans and revising them as necessary; completing all required forms, documentation, and reports in accordance with regulations and ACRC policies and procedures; rotating officer-of-the-day duties with other Service Coordinators; assisting co-workers with special projects, unique problems, vacation, and sick relief; and providing emergency on-call services when required.

The Early Intervention Service Coordinator will have cases anywhere in the Sacramento area and will provide case management and advocacy for children from birth to three years of age with a developmental delay, established risk condition, or who are at high risk of having a developmental disability. Responsibilities include conducting psychosocial and developmental screening assessments in the home environment; developing individual family service plans (IFSP) with families and collaborative agencies; coordinating services for infants and their families; determining ongoing eligibility of clients at age 3;

The Children Service Coordinator may have cases anywhere in the greater Sacramento area. This position serves children with developmental disabilities ages 3-18.

The Adult Service Coordinator serves adults with developmental disabilities over the age of 18.

The Residential Service Coordinator serves clients residing in licensed residential facilities.

_**REQUIREMENTS**_

Service Coordinators **must** have a Bachelor's degree or a Master's degree in Social work or a related field. Must have at least one year of professional experience in social work or a related field is preferred. Must demonstrate excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

Alta California Regional Center (ACRC) is a non-profit agency under contract to the State of California and for 50 years has provided the coordination of services to individuals with developmental disabilities. ACRC employs approximately 700 persons working out of eight offices in a ten-county area. ACRC is one of 21 Regional Centers in California

ACRC offers an excellent working environment and a benefits package to include 90% employer-paid health insurance plus low-cost dependent coverage including domestic partners; 100% employer-paid dental and vision insurance for employees plus dependents; 100% employer-paid employee life insurance coverage; 100% employer-paid long term disability coverage; flexible benefits pre-tax spending program; CalPERS employee pension plan; and 457 and 403-B voluntary tax shelter annuities. Other benefits include 17-22 annual vacation days, 12 annual sick days, 15 paid holidays, longevity leave, Employee Assistance Program, and many other generous benefits.

Emergency Medical Dispatchers help people requesting urgent medical assistance. Using an agency-approved system, they gather patient and incident information, establish response priorities, and support the coordination of emergency medical resources.

Depending on training, certification, and assignment, dispatchers may also provide approved instructions before responders arrive. These instructions must follow the employer’s medical dispatch protocols and oversight requirements.

12 days ago Requisition ID: 2092

Haymarket Media, Inc. is seeking a Marketing Coordinator to join the myCME/HME Campaign Performance team. This position can be based in our New York City or Paramus, NJ office on a hybrid work schedule; three (3) days in office depending on business needs.
**Job Overview:**
The Marketing Coordinator will work closely with the Senior Marketing Manager in the promotion and delivery of continuing medical education courses for three brands: myCME.com, Haymarket Medical Education (HME), and NACE.
**Responsibilities:**
Execute digital marketing campaigns to support overall campaign objectives and performance goals, including building emails and submitting scheduling requests to Email Ops
Review email schedule to ensure all campaigns are scheduled and deployed appropriately
Create and manage Learner Notifications within the proprietary LMS, ensuring timely and relevant communication
Facilitate cross-promotion across Haymarket Medical Network sister sites, ensuring accurate placement and timing including banner ads, newsletters, ad modules, etc.
Ensure accuracy and quality assurance across all marketing communications prior to deployment
Coordinate bi-monthly placement of activities on myCME.com specialty pages to enhance visibility and engagement
**Qualifications include:**
At least three (3) years of related work experience
BA/BS degree required in Marketing or Communications
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including creative/copywriting experience
Strong attention to detail
Excellent time management and communication skills
Self-starter who can multitask, solve problems, and take ownership of projects
Experience in HTML is a plus
Experience with Eloqua or other Email Service Providers is a plus
**What We Offer:**
A competitive compensation package
The salary range for this position is $55,000–$60,000. Compensation will be commensurate with experience, skill level, functional and/or industry knowledge, education level, certifications, as well as other qualifications.
Paid annual vacation, holiday and sick time off
Comprehensive health plans including medical, dental and vision
Competitive 401(k) investment options and generous company matching program
Life insurance
Employee referral awards
Training opportunities through industry-recognized programs
A creative and passionate workplace and a fun, collaborative team environment
Three Week “Work from Anywhere” benefit, to ensure work life balance
**About Haymarket Medical Education:**
Haymarket Medical Education (HME) is a leading provider of high-quality, independent continuing education (CE) for healthcare professionals (HCPs) including Physicians, Physician Associates, Nurse Practitioners, and Pharmacists, aiming to improve patient care through timely, evidence-based learning. HME designs and delivers dynamic programs, often hosted on its myCME platform, collaborating with academic centers and societies to translate scientific advances into daily practice, focusing on data-driven outcomes and interprofessional learning.
**About Haymarket:**
Haymarket Media, Inc. is an award-winning specialist content and information company. With more than 30 market-leading media brands, Haymarket offers unmatched expertise and insight through balanced, relevant, original content across a spectrum of media channels. Haymarket is home to highly regarded health care professional brands such as The Clinical Advisor, Dermatology Advisor, and MPR (Medical Professionals Reference) among a portfolio of HCP-focused, specialty-specific websites, as well as the esteemed business media titles including PRWeek, MM+M (Medical Marketing and Media), Campaign and McKnight’s Long-Term Care News.
Haymarket Media, Inc. is the US division of Haymarket Media Group. Haymarket Media Group is a privately-owned media, data and information company, shaping a better future with remarkable content for specialist audiences across the world. The company has 1,300 employees across offices in the UK, US, Canada, Hong Kong, Singapore, India, Germany and the Netherlands. Haymarket’s portfolio consists of more than 70 market-leading brands including Campaign, Third Sector, What Car?, MyCME and Asian Investor. Through live, digital, print, education, data, tech services, video and audio, Haymarket’s brands inspire, inform and empower clients and communities internationally. As a Certified B Corporation, we’re proud to be part of a community of companies working together for change, and taking part in collective action to advocate for a shared goal of a global economy that benefits people and the planet.
An equal opportunity employer, Haymarket Media does not discriminate in hiring or terms and conditions of employment because of an individual's race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected category recognized by state, federal, or local laws.

Overview
PPC Specialist (Paid Search Specialist) / Digital Marketing Specialist

This range is provided by Instinct Marketing. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Instinct Marketing provides local business clients with inbound online marketing strategies to generate leads. This includes search engine optimization (SEO), pay-per-click (PPC) advertising, website design & development, and more digital marketing services to improve the success of our clients' marketing efforts. Our agency is passionate about driving online success and helping businesses grow, with a focus on collaboration, clear communication, and a positive workplace culture.

Role
In this position, you'll work on various platforms, including Google Ads (PPC), Bing Ads (PPC), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram ads), and more. Responsibilities will vary according to client needs, but training will be provided. The ideal candidate has strong written skills, an eye for grammar, and is able to learn quickly but also dedicate themselves to learning beyond the training. We are looking for an analytical and dedicated individual who contributes to our company culture.

Responsibilities

Manage approximately 30-40+ local business clients that operate by completing builds, optimizations, change requests, and properly notate information for others to reference

Use advanced knowledge in online marketing while partnering with account managers to identify and report on key performance indicators and produce successful campaigns

Implement analysis of existing PPC campaign performance and prepare actionable insight for improvement to optimize account performance

Use Instinct Marketing best practices in digital marketing to develop strategies to achieve client goals in designing, developing, and managing PPC campaigns

Use a variety of tools to compile and draw insight from industry data to better understand user trends and behavior

Remain current with industry trends and best practices that may be incorporated to optimize accounts

Exercise discretion and independent judgment when creating and modifying client accounts to ensure ad campaigns are positively impacting the clients' goals, such as ROAS, brand exposure, and congruent ad-to-landing page web copy

Attend client meetings either in person or over the phone/Zoom

Produce monthly reports for clients and provide client recommendations

Requirements

Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills

Creative, analytical, and driven individual who works well on a team

Effective problem-solving skills

Strong attention to detail

Proficient in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace Applications

Preferred Experience

1 - 3 Years of Google Ads experience

Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising Certified

Facebook and Instagram Advertising Experience

Bachelor's Degree or 2+ years of SEM/PPC experience

Experience working with Google Analytics

Experience working with landing page builders such as Unbounce, GoHighLevel, or Instapage

Agency and client-facing experience

Google Ads Certified

Benefits

Paid medical, dental, and vision insurance

Paid holidays

Hybrid Schedule – 3 days in office, 2 days remote

About Instinct Marketing
Instinct Marketing is a digital marketing agency based in Sacramento, California. Our team mainly consists of SEO & PPC managers, specialists, SEO content writers, UX/UI designers, and web & software developers.

Work is primarily conducted in-office from Tuesday to Thursday, with remote work on Mondays and Fridays. # Marketing Manager

Jack

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2220479042469887295?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=9063709342219174300&crId=US_0US_0)

We need someone with 3+ years of experience in growth or performance marketing who has scaled paid acquisition at an early-stage, high-growth startup. You should be comfortable building from zero, running experiments end to end, and using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to multiply your output. Bonus points if you've marketed to consumer brands or worked in the creative/media/video space.
What you'll do:
Own and scale paid marketing across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and social channels targeting mid-market consumer brands
Design, launch, and measure growth experiments across paid ads, landing pages, messaging, and audiences
Build the growth engine from scratch — there's no existing playbook, infrastructure, or team to inherit
Drive organic growth through SEO, AEO, email, and lifecycle marketing
Work closely with Sales and Engineering to align campaigns with product launches and pipeline goals
Track performance, manage budgets, and optimize CAC and payback metrics
Leverage AI tools and the company's own platform to accelerate content creation and campaign execution
Collaborate with a dedicated content creator to produce high-performing creative assets
What we are looking for
4 - 6 years of experience in growth, performance, or demand- generation marketing
Excellent copywriting and messaging judgment
Scaled paid acquisition channels with measurable growth results (LinkedIn, Google, Meta, Tiktok, SEO / AEO)
Marketing experience targeting brands or consumer goods companies
Marketing SaaS, AI, or creative technology products
Worked at early-stage high-growth startup (Series A - Series C)
Proficient with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, agentic products)
Based in SF Bay Area; no relocation needed
Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or related field

# Office Manager

$65.6k - $78.28k

Associated Students, Inc

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-677806851359252637?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=186&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-350870845640606989&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

Job Announcement - Office Manager Early Childhood Education Center

Associated Students of SFSU is seeking an Office Manager to work at our Early Childhood Education Center. The Office Manager will perform a variety of tasks such as budget analysis, grant administration, client accounts, personnel files, purchasing, receiving, facility oversight, and receptionist duties. The Office Manager is an integral part of the Center management team and responsible for assisting the Director in all aspects of Center management.

Organization and Program Profile:

AS is the student government at SF State and serves as the official voice of students. AS promotes an enriched co-curricular student life experience and is dedicated to the empowerment of SF State’s diverse student body through a commitment to social justice and shared governance. AS provides and supports services and programs, maintains fiduciary responsibility, and engages in campus-wide collaborations and external advocacy efforts.

The ECEC’s primary goal is to assist student parents attain their educational goals by providing appropriate care for their young children in a high-quality, convenient and affordable educational setting. Our educational philosophy draws upon a variety of educational approaches to support each child’s optimum growth and development as well as make children’s learning visible.  As a campus-based childcare program, we also provide opportunities for student employment and Early Childhood teacher training.

Position Description:

The Early Childhood Education Center (ECEC) is seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and collaborative Office Manager to support the day-to-day administrative and business operations of the Center.  Reporting to the ECEC Director, the **Office Manage** r is an integral member of the Center’s management team and provides support across a variety of operational areas, including client accounts, budget and financial administration, personnel records, purchasing, grant and program documentation, licensing compliance, facilities coordination, and general office administration.

This Full-Time (non-exempt 12-month) position is ideal for someone who enjoys managing multiple priorities, working with families and staff, maintaining accurate records, and helping ensure the smooth operation of a busy early childhood education environment.

**Center Hours of operation** are 7:30 am - 5:00 pm.

**Work schedule** : between the hours of 7:15am – 5:15 pm.  Occasional overtime work may be required to meet critical project deadlines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

The Office Manager will:

- Manage client and family accounts, including enrollment and attendance records, account documentation, payment follow-up, and required statistical reporting.
- Support business and financial operations, including purchase orders, requisitions, expense tracking, revenue records, agency-funded accounts, invoices, reimbursements, and monthly financial reporting.
- Maintain personnel and compliance records for employees, substitutes, volunteers, interns, and practicum students, including required licensing and fingerprint documentation.
- Prepare Personnel Action Notices (PANs), assist with employee orientation processes, and maintain required personnel documentation.
- Lead and direct part-time Office Assistants and substitute teachers in support of Center operations.
- Maintain required Community Care Licensing (CCL) forms, facility records, and other regulatory documentation.
- Support the Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP), including program documentation, meal forms, menu coordination, ordering, reimbursement claims, and compliance requirements.
- Coordinate office purchasing, supplies, equipment, keys, and inventory.
- Serve as a liaison for building maintenance requests and collaborate with Facilities and IT as needed.
- Provide administrative and customer service support to families, staff, visitors, and other members of the campus community.
- Assist with enrollment materials, waitlists, Center communications, publications, and other administrative projects.

**Qualifications: What We’re Looking For**

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

- Strong organizational, prioritization, and multitasking skills in a busy work environment.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate records.
- Experience working with computerized databases, spreadsheets, and administrative systems.
- Knowledge of accounts receivable and basic accounting practices.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
- Ability to communicate effectively and respectfully with families, staff, students, and individuals from a wide range of backgrounds.
- Knowledge of Community Care Licensing (CCL) regulations and childcare-related compliance requirements.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace; experience with childcare management and reporting systems is desirable.

**Education & Experience**

- Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS); a business-related field is preferred.
- Two years of experience directly related to the duties and responsibilities of the position.
- Previous experience working in a childcare program is preferred.
- Current Pediatric First Aid and CPR certification is required.

**Salary/Benefits**

Salary Range: $65,600 – 78,282 annually based on qualifications and experience.

This position receives grant funding through the San Francisco Department of Early Childhood.

AS provides an excellent comprehensive benefits package including;

- Medical (CalPERS), dental, vision, for employees and qualified dependents
- 12.5% equivalent of salary towards 403(b) Retirement Plan
- Life insurance (Basic and AD&D Dependent Term Life)
- Long Term disability
- 14 Paid holidays plus Personal Holiday
- Sick leave accrued over time, approximately 12 days per year
- Vacation accrued over time, approximately 15 days per year

**Start Date:**

Successful candidates will begin interviewing: October 19, 2026

$30 - $38 per hour

OmniAb

About OmniAb

OmniAb provides our pharmaceutical industry partners access to the most diverse antibody repertoires and cutting-edge screening technologies to enable discovery of next-generation therapeutics. We leverage our state-of-the-art technologies to facilitate the discovery of best-in-class antibodies. Within OmniAb are also core capabilities for the discovery and screening of high-value ion channel and transporter targets.

OmniAb consists of dynamic, collaborative and innovative team members that are passionate about contributing to the technological frontier of drug discovery and to the advancement of global human health. Together, with our partners, we are enabling the discovery of next-generation therapeutics.

About This Role

We are seeking an Office Administrator to manage our front desk and support day-to-day office operations. This role will focus on maintaining a welcoming, well-organized, and well-stocked office environment and supporting onsite employees and visitors with administrative and office-related needs. The Office Administrator will play a key role in ensuring smooth office operations at our Emeryville headquarters. The ideal candidate is customer-service-focused with experience with office administration and logistics, workplace operations and maintenance, and site visits and events.

This role reports to the SVP, People and Talent.

This is a permanent part-time position. This is an onsite position based out of our Emeryville headquarters, and the working hours are generally within 8am-3pm PT (25-30 hours per week) with some flexibility as needed.

What You'll Do

\\* Manage the front desk, visitor badges and logs, and access to the office space.

\\* Manage day-to-day operations of the Emeryville office, ensuring an organized, and productive workspace.

\\* Partner with teams across the organization to support office logistics and general administrative needs.

\\* Manage shipping and receiving of office mail and packages.

\\* Coordinate office facilities, maintenance, vendor relationships, and service contracts to support business needs.

\\* Order and maintain office supplies, kitchen snacks, beverages, and general employee resources.

\\* Manage the upkeep of office kitchens and common areas.

\\* Manage the employee and marketing swag inventory.

\\* Support and help coordinate onsite office visitors, company meetings, and candidate interviews.

\\* Support employee committees, activities, and events.

\\* Support travel arrangements, accommodations, and expense processing for visitors as needed.

\\* Support employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including workspace setup, equipment management, and coordination with cross-functional teams.

\\* Support workspace planning and facility improvement projects.

\\* Manage the People Team Intranet Page and continually improve the OmniAb Intranet employee experience, including reviewing and improving pages and collaborating on new department content.

\\* Support community partnerships and employer branding, including planning school lab tours, biotech networking events, and other initiatives.

\\* Perform other office and administrative duties as assigned.

What You Bring

\\* BA in a relevant field is preferred.

\\* 3+ years of experience in an office administration role in a professional corporate environment.

\\* Experience supporting office operations, vendor management, and administrative processes.

\\* Experience coordinating meetings, events, travel logistics, and other operational activities.

\\* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

\\* Strong interpersonal skills with a customer service-oriented mindset and the ability to build relationships across all levels of the organization.

\\* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt based on priorities.

\\* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

\\* Reliable, proactive, and able to work independently while exercising discretion with confidential information.

Nice To Have

\\* Familiarity with procurement tools, company intranets, or expense processing systems.

\\* Familiarity using Canva or another graphic design tool.

The base compensation range for this position is $30 - $38 per hour. The range provided is an estimate. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, experience, education, location, and other factors permitted by law.

# Administrative Assistant

$90k - $100k

Career Group

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7389616357050529932?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1355011229002854477&crId=US_0US_0)

San Francisco, CA \| $90,000-$100,000 Base + Bonus \| Fully On-Site
Our client, a leading private equity firm, is seeking a polished, proactive, and highly organized Administrative Assistant to support four Managing Directors within a collaborative team of seven administrative professionals. Reporting to the Office Manager, this role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who excels in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and can seamlessly balance competing priorities while delivering exceptional administrative support.

The successful candidate will be a quick learner with strong judgment, excellent follow-through, and the ability to anticipate executive needs while adapting to different working styles and preferences. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrative professional to join a high-performing team in a professional, high-expectation environment.

What You'll Do

Provide day-to-day administrative support to four Managing Directors, helping ensure their schedules, priorities, and responsibilities run smoothly.

Manage complex calendars, coordinate meetings, and proactively navigate scheduling conflicts while learning each executive's individual preferences and priorities.

Arrange primarily domestic business travel, including transportation, accommodations, and detailed itineraries.

Process and track expenses using Concur and other internal systems, ensuring accuracy and timely submission.

Monitor high volumes of emails, requests, and administrative tasks, identifying urgent priorities and ensuring timely follow-through.

Prepare and refine presentations and meeting materials, including proofreading, formatting, converting documents to PDF, and printing.

Coordinate meeting logistics, conference rooms, materials, and other in-office arrangements.

Welcome clients and guests, providing a polished and professional experience during office visits and meetings.

Collaborate closely with the administrative team to coordinate coverage, share responsibilities, and provide additional support as needed.

Maintain a high level of responsiveness, professionalism, and attention to detail while managing time-sensitive requests.

Provide additional support during peak periods and work overtime as needed to accommodate business priorities.

What We're Looking For

2-7 years of relevant administrative or Executive Assistant experience preferred.

Previous experience supporting executives in private equity, finance, law, consulting, or another professional services environment is a plus.

Strong customer service skills and experience interacting professionally with clients and senior stakeholders.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain accuracy in a high-volume environment.

Proactive and anticipatory, with the ability to recognize needs, identify potential scheduling conflicts, and stay ahead of competing demands.

A quick learner who can adapt to different executive personalities, preferences, and working styles.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a polished, professional demeanor.

Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and reliable follow-through.

Flexible, responsive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with high expectations.

Collaborative team player who takes initiative and is willing to step in wherever support is needed.

Willingness and availability to work overtime as needed.

Schedule & Location

Monday-Friday, fully on-site in San Francisco, CA.

Two weeks of work-from-home flexibility in August and two weeks in December.

Overtime as needed based on business demands.

$90,000-$100,000 base salary, depending on experience and qualifications.

Benefits package.

Paid time off.

Overtime as applicable.

# Administrative Assistant - Bilingual

$27.5 per hour

Hamilton Families

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6530606141419218294?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5112263956068276404&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Hamilton Families

Our mission is to end family homelessness in the San Francisco Bay Area. We believe that the San Francisco Bay Area is at its best when people from all backgrounds can start a life here, raise a family here, and thrive here.

Hamilton Families envisions a Bay Area where housing is accessible and affordable, where homelessness is rare, brief, and nonrecurring, and where all people and families have a safe and stable place to live. Established in 1985, Hamilton Families is San Francisco's leading nonprofit social service provider to families experiencing homelessness, with carefully designed programs to prevent family homelessness, provide emergency shelter and transitional housing to families in times of need, support the well-being of children who experience homelessness, and quickly return families to safe and stable housing providing them the resources and case management needed to achieve long-term housing stability. We currently operate these programs across multiple sites in San Francisco and the Greater Bay Area.

##### Position Overview

Under the direction of the Chief Operating Officer, the Administrative Assistant performs a variety of administrative, receptionist, and clerical tasks to ensure efficient operation of the office. Duties include providing support to our managers and employees in administrative departments (e.g., Finance, HR, Development, and IT), assisting in daily office needs, and managing tasks related to organization and communication in an accurate and timely manner. Hamilton Families is looking for a master multi-tasker with excellent communication skills and an upbeat attitude to ensure that we provide excellent service to the families we serve, while providing comfortable, safe, and welcoming work environments to staff, visitors, and volunteers.

##### Primary Duties and Responsibilities

• Provides administrative support to ensure efficient operation of our Mission office.

• Serves visitors by greeting, welcoming and directing them appropriately.

• Organize and manage internal tools and files (clerical tasks and database management).

• First point of contact for basic facilities issues, IT support and troubleshooting.

• Operates phone system and manages mainline of organization.

• Planning, scheduling, and promoting office events, including meetings, conferences, interviews, orientations, celebrations, and training sessions.

• Ensures operation of office equipment and fleet of vehicles by completing preventive maintenance requirements, managing repairs, and auditing inventories.

• Maintain office supplies by checking stock to determine inventory level, anticipating needed supplies, placing and expediting orders for supplies.

• Preparing common areas such as meeting rooms, kitchens and restrooms.

• Draft office and organization wide communications. Write and distribute mail, memos, letters, faxes, and forms.

• Collect, sort and distribute inbound mail for the office.

• Submit expense reports and income logs.

• Assist in the onboarding and offboarding processes for employees.

• Collaborate with various teams across the organization.

• Keep abreast of all organizational changes.

• Other administrative projects as assigned.

##### Qualifications, Skills and Abilities

• Prior experience in related field with administrative systems and staff.

• Time, task, and resource management skills with proven organizational skills.

• Strong problem solving, critical thinking, interpersonal, and verbal and written communication skills.

• Detail oriented and able to anticipate the needs of others to ensure their seamless and positive experience.

• Proficiency with computers (especially knowledge of MS Office, Slack, and Asana) and comfort with basic IT troubleshooting.

• Ability to work with people from a variety of backgrounds including low-tech experienced staff members.

• Able to work a varying schedule based on events, including outside business hours.

• Essential functions of the position may require the use of a telephone, working at a standard computer terminal, and the ability to follow reasonable ergonomic recommendations, sit, kneel, stand, drive, or walk for long periods, reach, bend, lift, carry up to 50 pounds, and ability to climb stairs as needed.

• Valid CADL and clean DMV record; able and willing to travel locally as needed.

• Criminal background check, fingerprint imaging, TB (Tuberculosis) clearance, and documentation required post offer.

We encourage applicants to apply even if they feel they do not meet all the listed criteria. We value diverse perspectives and believe in the potential for growth and development within our team. Your unique skills and experiences may be exactly what we need to succeed together.

##### Why Choose Us

- Enjoy excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
- Employer matched 403(b) retirement plan
- Wellness and commuter benefit programs
- Paid time off and holidays

##### Our Values

- Resourceful
- Helpful/"Yes, And"
- Growth mindset
- Data Informed
- EDI: Equitable, Diverse, and Inclusive

$70.5k

Full-time

**Receptionist, Administrative Assistant _Position:_Financial Technology Partners is seeking a Receptionist, Administrative Assistant for their San Francisco Office, 5 days a week in office. _Company Description:_Financial Technology Partners (aka “FT Partners”) is the only investment banking firm focused exclusively on the financial technology sector. We broadly define the sector as the dynamic convergence of technology-based solutions and financial services. FT Partners was recently recognized as "Dealmaker of the Year" and "Investment Banking Firm of the Year" by the M&A Advisor.**
**The firm was founded by Steve McLaughlin, Managing Partner, formerly a senior investment banker in Goldman Sachs & Co.'s Financial Technology Group and Financial Institutions Group in New York and San Francisco. The firm's Founder and senior bankers are all highly experienced investment bankers formerly with the financial technology, M&A and investment banking groups of Goldman Sachs & Co in New York, San Francisco, London, and Los Angeles.**
**_Role Description:_ In this role, the Receptionist, Administrative Assistant will play a vital role in creating a positive impression and ensuring smooth operations within the office. The primary responsibilities include but are not limited to: greeting guests and employees, serving as the main point of contact with the building management team, handling catering, managing conference room scheduling, maintaining office and kitchen supplies, distributing documents, assisting with administrative and organizational projects, and keeping the public space clean and organized. They will also assist with team events and provide administrative support to employees as assigned. _General Qualifications:_**

**- Minimum of 0-2 years of experience in a reception and or administrative support role**
**- Highly organized with great attention to detail, strong written and verbal communication skills, and ability to perform in a busy, multi-tasking work environment.**
**- Extremely organized and technology savvy.**
**- Comfortable in a vibrant office environment**
**- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.**
**- Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)**
**- Demonstrated ability to work independently and on a team.**
**- A self-starter and ability to anticipate needs.**
**- Bachelor's Degree required**
**- U.S. work authorization**

**Salary: $70,500_Communications Skills_**

**- Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills, able to prepare high impact materials.**
**- Participates effectively in both internal and external meetings.**
**- Maturity and poise to work directly with client executives.**

**_Team Player_**

**- Team player who can contribute to building a positive team spirit, keeps commitments, inspires the trust of others, works with integrity and ethically, and upholds firm values.**
**- Ability to perform under pressure, amid tight deadlines; can effectively prioritize and plan.**
**- Collaborative across teams and levels, both internally and externally.**
**- Understands coaching for long term development of self and others.**

**_Why FT Partners?_**

**- Managing Partner and Managing Directors formerly of Goldman Sachs and JP Morgan**
**- Award-winning execution; Investment Bank of the Year / Boutique of the Year Awards (among many others)**
**- Executing both billion dollar and early stage / high-growth VC transactions**
**- Excellent career path, strong and competitive compensation**
**- Unparalleled deal flow with premier client base**
**- Access to world-class executives at high-growth companies**
**- Dominant footprint in the one of largest sectors: financial technology**
**- Top-notch financial sponsor relationships**
**- Close-knit, rapidly growing team**

**_Selected transactions include advising:_**

**- \- Divvy's $2.5 billion Sale to Bill.com**
**- GreenSky’s $2.2 billion Sale to Goldman Sachs**
**- Forge’s $2 billion Merger with Motive Capital Corp.**
**- Truebill’s $1.3 billion Sale to Rocket Companies**
**- Revolut's $800 million Financing at a $33 billion Valuation**
**- SpotOn’s $300 million Series F Financing at a $3.6 billion Valuation**
**- Upgrade’s $280 million Series F Financing at a $6 billion Valuation**
**- CAIS’ $225 million Series C Financing at a $1 billion+ Valuation**
**- Bilt’s $200 million Financing at a $3.1 billion valuation**
**- Newfront’s $200 million Financing at a $2.2 billion Valuation**
**- DailyPay’s $75 million Financing at a $1.8 billion Valuation**
**- Cart.com’s $60 million Series C Financing at $1.2 billion Valuation**
**- Acorn’s Acquisition of GoHenry**

### Job Description

Job Description

**Front Desk Associate**

**Starting Salary Range: $42,193 - $50,632**

GGRC is looking to hire a Front Desk Associate to be the first point of contact for visitors and calls to our San Francisco headquarters. This position will greet, answer questions, and direct inquiries as needed while performing daily front desk tasks and responsibilities.

**Front Desk**

- Front desk
- Open or close the office/Front Desk for business hours.
- Professionally answer, address, assist, and direct incoming phone calls, voice messages, or inquiries.
- Courteously greet and assist incoming visitors.
- Provide basic information regarding GGRC application processes.
- Create and distribute SF Out-of-office/Officer of the Day notifications.
- Track and Distribute SF Staff Parking Vouchers
- Track and Distribute Temporary Badges
- Review and forward incoming faxes from our general fax line.
- Run visitor reports and assist building security desks with unexpected drop-in visitors.
- Maintain and organize GGRC reception area/waiting room for cleanliness.
- Receive or assist with incoming deliveries or packages and out-going delivery or package pick-up.
- Provide front desk coverage for Board of Director meetings.
- Serve as phone back-up to other GGRC office front desk staff.
- Assist with SF Conference or Meeting Room reservations.
- Assist with visitor registrations as needed.

Other

- Sort or process daily mail as needed.
- Hold and distribute various department items for staff as directed.
- Additional tasks and projects as assigned.

**Requirements**

**Education/Experience**

- High School Diploma or equivalent
- 3+ years in an office setting with front desk reception, office assistant, or customer service oriented duties

**Competencies**

- Technical Literacy
- Communication and Interpersonal Skills with Active Listening
- Professional Etiquette
- Organized
- Agile Multitasking and Prioritization
- Collaboration/Teamwork

**General Skills**

- Dependable
- Technology proficient with Microsoft 365 programs
- Familiarity with Zoom Phones a plus, but not required
- Strong communication skills, oral and written
- Strong listening skills
- Ability to respond empathetically and appropriately as needed
- Ability to problem solve spontaneously
- Ability to maintain a calm demeanor under stressful situations or conversations
- Strong customer service skills
- Professional demeanor

**Desired Qualifications**

- Coursework in Office Administration or related areas
- Experience in multi-cultural settings
- Bilingual capacity, particularly English/Spanish or English/Cantonese

**Benefits**

**What are the benefits to working with GGRC?**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including Medical and Dental benefits with a generous employer contribution and additional employer paid Life, Disability and Vision coverage

10% employer contribution to a 403(b) retirement account to help you save for the future!

**GENEROUS TIME OFF BENEFITS!!!**

No really, we mean generous:

13 vacation days, 15 sick days, 11 paid holidays, 6 personal days and up to 5 paid days for continuing education

**What makes GGRC so special?**

GGRC values diversity, we believe in creating an environment where people of all backgrounds can collaborate to find solutions to complex problems. We are community minded and passionate.

GGRC values each person as a full, robust, and unique individual and interacts with each person in a manner that is respectful and responsive. We endeavor to place each person at the center of his, her or their own life. We approach each person as an expert on his, her or their own life and identity with a clear and attentive inquiry into what is important to, as well as important for, that one person (whether coworker or person-served, family member or other stakeholder).

**How to apply:**

GGRC values diversity; people of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Please complete the application and submit your most recent resume. If you feel that the questions do not accurately capture what you have to offer Golden Gate Regional Center, you are also welcome to attach a cover letter. Applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis so we encourage you to submit yours soon. We look forward to reading your application.

Golden Gate Regional Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

## Executive Assistant

Thornton Tomasetti applies engineering and scientific principles to solve the world's challenges. An independent organization of creative thinkers and innovative doers collaborating from offices worldwide, our mission is to bring our clients' ideas to life and, in the process, lay the groundwork for a better, more resilient future. We provide support and opportunities to our employees to achieve their full potential and cultivate a rewarding career.

### The Role

The Executive Assistant is a trusted partner to the Office Director and Principal, providing strategic and administrative support in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role is central to keeping operations running smoothly, acting as a liaison across leadership, and ensuring priorities are executed with precision and professionalism.

### Responsibilities

- Serve as a primary partner to senior leadership, managing complex calendars, priorities, and day-to-day operations
- Coordinate meetings, travel, communications, and materials (presentations, reports, and correspondence)
- Act as a liaison between executives, internal teams, and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication
- Handle confidential information with discretion while proactively anticipating needs and solving problems
- Support special projects, outreach efforts, and executive initiatives with strong organization and follow-through

### Requirements

- Bachelor's degree with 5+ years supporting senior executives in a high-level administrative role
- Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills with the ability to meet tight deadlines
- A proactive, collaborative mindset with strong judgment and attention to detail
- Flexibility and commitment to excellence, including availability outside standard business hours when needed

### Compensation

The rate for this position generally is $35 - $45 hourly. This range is a good faith estimate provided pursuant to the California Pay Transparency Law. It is based on what a successful California applicant might be paid and assumes that the successful candidate will be in California or perform the position from California. Similar positions located outside of California will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Actual pay rates may vary from the range, as permitted by California Equal Pay Transparency Law. Compensation offers will be based on various factors, including operational needs, individual education, qualifications and experience, work location and comparison to employee already in the role, as well as other considerations permitted by law. A potential new employee's pay history will not be used in compensation decisions.

### Benefits

Depending on your employment status, benefits may include:

- Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability and other voluntary benefits
- Flexible Spending Accounts for Medical and Childcare
- Paid Time Off, Family Leave for New Parents, Volunteer Time
- Tuition Reimbursement
- Commuter Transit (where available)
- 401k retirement savings with Company matching on employee contributions and/or qualified student loan repayments
- Fitness Reimbursement
- And other various wellness, diversity/inclusion and employee resource programs and initiatives

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Business Unit Commercial & Investment Bank
Posting Date 07/06/2026, 02:51 PM
Locations 560 Mission St, San Francisco, CA, 94105, US
Job Schedule Full time
Job Description Become an integral part of Commercial & Investment Banking team where you will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced organization and each day will be unique! This role provides a platform for professional growth and skill enhancement. Be part of a team that is results-oriented, with a focus on attention to detail and quality.
As an Executive Assistant in Commercial & Investment Banking, you will need to work well in a team environment, be able to represent the manager/group with professional courtesy and acumen, and deliver flawless work output. Your daily routine also includes interaction with various executive level internal clients across the lines of businesses. You will need to adapt procedures, processes and techniques to complete assignments in line with the department's activities and goals.
Job responsibilities
Maintain complex and detailed calendars
Screen incoming calls and determine the level of priority, while using caution in dispensing information
Manage the coordination and logistics of both internal and external meetings
Arrange and coordinate complicated domestic and international travel
Organize all aspects of internal and external events, including catering and transportation
Process invoices and T&E expense claims for team members, ensuring all policies are followed and items are processed within provided guidelines
Assist with staff on-boarding and off-boarding, which includes requesting equipment setup and system access
Produce high quality emails and messages to individuals at all levels of the organization
Maintain department documents, including current organizational charts and Executive Bio’s
Handle regular activities without prompting, and advise in advance with issues or delays
Assist in editing spreadsheets and presentations, including printing and binding, for client meetings
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
At least five years of administrative experience
Advanced ability to organize
Discretion and good judgment in confidential situations, and proven experience interacting with senior management
Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office
Excellent telephone etiquette and ability to manage competing priorities i.e. calendar management
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Experience supporting at the Managing Director level (or equivalent) or above
College degree is a plus

Kelly

[South San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/South-San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2819800377413407328?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7512&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2726798328663265068&crId=US_0US_0)

## Executive Administrative Assistant

Join our dynamic Translational Safety team as an experienced administrative professional, providing high-level support to Director-level leadership and their immediate functional areas, including Toxicology, Pathology, and/or gRED Nonclinical Operations (gNO). This role enables scientific and operational success by delivering proactive, reliable, and strategic administrative assistance in a complex and highly collaborative environment.

Location: South San Francisco, CA Pay rate: $35/hr Shift: Regular hours Onsite (may transition to 3 days onsite per week)

### Key Responsibilities

- Manage and optimize multiple complex calendars, ensuring seamless scheduling and prioritization of meetings and critical events
- Act as a key point of contact, facilitating timely, clear, and effective communication across the team and with cross-functional partners
- Coordinate logistics for onsite and offsite meetings, conferences, and team-building events, including vendor engagement and material preparation
- Arrange domestic and international travel, and manage related conference and event attendance
- Process invoices, payments, and expense reports using standard corporate tools, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies
- Continuously identify opportunities for process improvements, offering practical recommendations that enhance administrative efficiency
- Exercise sound judgment and discretion in managing sensitive and confidential information
- Maintain and update records and tracking tools using various computer applications (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace)
- Serve as a valued department resource, providing support and guidance to staff and acting as a liaison with other administrative teams
- Provide backup coverage to administrative colleagues as needed
- Foster a strong customer service focus and collaborative team participation
- May assume responsibility for coordinating and assigning administrative work within the team
- Carry out other duties as assigned to support departmental and organizational goals

### Qualifications

- High School Diploma required; BS/BA degree preferred
- 5-10 years of demonstrated administrative experience or equivalent transferable skills

- Ability to manage both routine and ad-hoc assignments independently, with minimal supervision
