# Executive Administrative Assistant

$167k - $181k

LB Pharmaceuticals

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2621824712892783443?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=162&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4993663233812670751&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

The Executive Administrative Assistant will play a critical role in supporting the **CEO** and **SVP of Corporate Affairs** by managing their day-to-day operations, communications, calendars, travel, and logistics. This role requires a strong partnership with both executives and someone who is proactive, adaptable, resourceful, anticipatory, and capable of working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. This role will also require close coordination with other executive admins particularly those supporting externally facing executives. The ideal candidate will bring excellent organizational and communication skills, sound judgment, an understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism. **This position is expected to operate primarily within East Coast Time (7am PT to 3pm PT).**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Executive Partnership & Support**

- Provide dedicated support to the CEO and SVP, Corporate Affairs, serving as a trusted partner in managing priorities, schedules, communications, and day-to-day logistics.
- Proactively manage complex and frequently changing calendars, resolve scheduling conflicts, and ensure alignment with business priorities.
- Organize and prioritize the executives’ daily activities to help them focus on the highest-value work.
- Anticipate executive needs, exercise sound judgment, and ensure leaders are well prepared for meetings, events, and external engagements.
- Prepare and edit correspondence, presentations, reports, and materials for executive-level meetings.
- Manage competing requests and priorities with professionalism, discretion, and appropriate follow-through.

**Meeting, Travel & Event Coordination**

- Coordinate Board and committee meetings, investor meetings, West Coast Executive Team gatherings, and other key company meetings, including logistics, materials, and follow-up.
- Coordinate Board and committee meetings with other Boards that executive serves on including expense reimbursement with that company.
- Coordinate Board dinners, leadership gatherings, and other executive events.

- In collaboration with People & Culture and Corporate Affairs, coordinate All Hands meetings and company events.
- Manage end-to-end travel arrangements, including detailed itineraries, accommodations, transportation, changes, and expense reporting.
- Provide on-the-ground support for conferences, partner meetings, and company events, as needed.

**Communication & Liaison**

- Act as a primary point of contact for the executives with internal and external stakeholders, including Board members, investors, partners, and company leaders.
- Triage meeting requests and routine communications, escalating matters appropriately and ensuring timely follow-up.
- Serve as a liaison to department heads and team members, facilitating clear communication and collaboration.
- Draft routine correspondence and communications for executive review or distribution as appropriate.

**Confidentiality & Documentation**

- Manage sensitive information and documentation with the highest level of discretion and integrity.
- Coordinate the execution of confidentiality agreements and other documentation required for meetings with third parties.
- Maintain organized records, meeting materials, and other executive documentation.

**Project & Administrative Support**

- Assist with special projects and operational tasks across the organization.
- Track key actions and follow-up items arising from executive and leadership meetings.
- Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, coordination, and executive efficiency.

**Location & Work Schedule**

- **This position is based on the West Coast and is expected to operate primarily within East Coast Time (7am PT to 3pm PT)**
- Given the executives supported are frequently engaged across time zones, flexibility to support East Coast meetings and business activities as needed is required.
- In the event a West Coast office is established, being in the office 3 days per week would be expected
- Ability to travel to NY city periodically particularly to support in person board meetings (2 times per year) or large in company meetings and participation in face-to-face weeks (2 times per year)
- Ability to adjust working hours periodically to support executive, Board, investor, and company priorities.

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree preferred.
- Minimum of 5 years of **experience supporting a CEO** and/or other C-suite executives, preferably in a startup or fast-growth environment and ideally within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare sectors.
- Proven experience managing complex executive calendars, travel, meetings, expenses, and sensitive correspondence.
- Experience coordinating Board meetings, investor interactions, or senior external stakeholder engagements preferred.
- Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with strong attention to detail.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- High level of professionalism, discretion, integrity, and sound judgment.
- Familiarity with pharmaceutical industry terminology, regulations, and operations is a plus.
- Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams. Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana or Monday.com is a plus.

**Personal Attributes**

- Proactive and able to anticipate the needs of the executives.
- Highly adaptable and comfortable working in an evolving, entrepreneurial environment.
- Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels of the organization.
- Resourceful, solutions-oriented, and able to handle unexpected challenges with professionalism.
- Collaborative and committed to building a strong, trusted partnership with the executives supported.

**What Success Looks Like**

- Enables seamless day-to-day operations for the CEO and SVP, Corporate Affairs by proactively managing calendars, priorities, communications, travel, and logistics.
- Builds a strong, trusted partnership with both executives and anticipates needs and addresses potential problems before they arise.
- Builds a strong, trusted partnership with other executive admins and can provide back-up support for the company
- Able to juggle multiple items in a fast-moving environment

- Resolves scheduling, travel, and operational challenges quickly and with sound judgment.
- Serves as a reliable and professional point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
- Delivers consistently high-quality work with accuracy, attention to detail, and strict confidentiality.
- Provides responsive support across time zones while balancing Pacific Time responsibilities with East Coast meetings and business needs.

The posted salary range reflects the minimum to maximum base pay for this position in the specified location. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, experience, education, licensure requirements, and skill level, and will be determined at the time of offer. Base Salary Range: $167K-$181K.

**The Values We Hope You Share**

**Purpose Driven**– We are optimistic, focused and committed to delivering on our vision. We are hard-working, compliant, relentless and impatient in our pursuit of treatments. We set competitive company goals to significantly and positively impact the lives of our patients, employees and shareholders. We have a sense of urgency to every action we make.

**Transparent**– We trust each other and expect honest and open communication to enable good decision making. We are humble, genuine and direct. Words match our behaviors. We hold each other accountable. We embrace the tough conversations to achieve success.

**Bold**– We are courageous in our pursuit of excellence. Unafraid of risks. Unafraid of challenging assumptions. Unafraid of challenges. Unafraid of success.

**Intelligent**– We are curious, passionate and self-aware. We are agile, adaptable and seek diverse experience, knowledge, and skills to make informed, data driven decisions. We anticipate the needs of others, and we adapt quickly to challenges and find solutions. We rely on our collective experiences to diligently develop, strategically plan and efficiently execute our vision.

**Unified**– We collaborate as we strive for excellence. We rely on each other, and we have each other’s backs. We encourage constructive feedback to continually improve. We support each other; we laugh together. We celebrate each other’s successes and band together in times of hardship. We foster and appreciate genuine relationships.

Our values underpin the employee experience at LB Pharmaceuticals. They are the character and personality of the company demonstrated through how we communicate, support one another, spend our time, make decisions, and celebrate collectively.

# Billing Specialist

ABM Industries

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6137867152238528689?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-557260488766467171&crId=US_0US_0)

Job-ID: 167280Location: San Francisco, CA, United StatesWorkplace: HybridSchedule: Full timePosted: 2026-10-06The Billing and Revenue Analyst is responsible for the oversight and analysis of the full billing, collections, and revenue recognition process to ensure accurate financial reporting and strong cash flow performance. This role works closely with project managers, finance, and accounting teams to ensure that all project billings and revenue are properly recorded within Oracle Financials / Project Accounting, in accordance with GAAP and ASC 606 standards.Benefits: ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visitABM Employee Benefits: Staff & MgmtCompensation: $30/hr (US Dollars)The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.QualificationsEducation & Experience· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.· 3+ years of experience in billing, revenue accounting, or project accounting roles.· Hands-on experience with Oracle Financials, especially Project Accounting and Accounts Receivable modules.· Working knowledge of GAAP and ASC 606 revenue recognition principles.Skills· Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.· Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.· Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.· Strong communication and interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration.ResponsibilitiesBilling & Invoicing· Prepare, review, and issue customer invoices through Oracle Project Accounting, ensuring accuracy, compliance with contracts, and timely delivery.· Validate project setup, funding limits, billing rules, and milestones before invoice generation.· Coordinate with project management and operations teams to resolve billing discrepancies.· Maintain complete and accurate billing records supporting monthly and quarterly financial close processes.Collections & Accounts Receivable· Monitor and manage accounts receivable aging to ensure prompt collection of outstanding invoices.· Communicate with customers to resolve billing or payment issues and drive timely collections.· Apply cash receipts and reconcile customer accounts within Oracle AR.· Support monthly AR reporting and analysis, including DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) metrics and trend monitoring.Revenue Recognition· Apply appropriate revenue recognition rules in accordance with ASC 606 and company policies.· Ensure accurate timing and classification of revenue for project-based contracts.· Reconcile billed revenue, unbilled revenue, and deferred revenue balances during monthly close.· Support accounting leadership in audits, reconciliations, and variance analyses related to revenue.Financial Reporting & Analysis· Prepare and analyze billing, collections, and revenue reports for management review.· Identify variances and recommend process improvements to strengthen accuracy and efficiency.· Collaborate with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue planning initiatives.About the company
ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience.

ABM serves a wide range of market sectors including commercial real estate, aviation, education, mission critical, and manufacturing and distribution. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. Committed to creating smarter, more connected spaces, ABM is investing in the future to meet evolving challenges and build a healthier, thriving world. ABM: Driving possibility, together.

Our client is seeking a diligent and experienced billing coordinator to join their team on a contract basis. This role will assist in managing billing activities for a designated portfolio of legal professionals and clients.
Full-time: M-F
Hybrid (3 days onsite)
**Responsibilities:**
Develop in-depth understanding of client-specific billing arrangements, including terms, rate structures, and invoicing preferences.
Generate and process invoices promptly and accurately, aligning with contractual agreements and discount terms.
Utilize best practices to review, format, and distribute billing drafts and finalized invoices to clients.
Ensure all submissions, especially electronic invoices, meet client-specific documentation and timeline requirements.
Manage invoice revisions and billing adjustments promptly to maintain smooth cash flow and client satisfaction.
Oversee billing activity for assigned attorneys, providing regular updates on outstanding billables and aged accounts.
Collaborate with legal support staff and leadership to escalate and resolve overdue or disputed charges.
Recommend financial write-offs where collections are no longer feasible or practical.
Respond to information requests regarding billing details, account balances, accruals, and transaction discrepancies.
Act as an advisor on billing protocols, policies, and compliance measures for internal and client-facing communications.
Generate and distribute reports detailing unbilled hours and expenses for active matters.
Review and resolve underpaid invoices by identifying discrepancies and following up accordingly.
Leverage data tools (such as Excel and internal dashboards) to fulfill ad hoc reporting and data analysis needs.
Support cash application by identifying and resolving unidentified payments efficiently.
Help staff and attorneys resolve time entry and matter allocation issues.
Coordinate with the Pricing Team for review and approval of any proposed alternative billing structures.
Maintain accurate records of billing procedures, key deadlines, and client-specific preferences.
Assist with legal audit responses by promptly providing requested financial records and account details.
**Qualifications:**
2+ years of experience in a professional services firm
Proficiency in billing systems like 3E, Elite, or Aderant
Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Strong collaboration and communication skills with a professional demeanor
Client-focused mindset with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
Able to operate independently and handle sensitive information with discretion
Flexibility to work extended hours during peak periods to meet billing deadlines
Seniority level Seniority level Associate
Employment type Employment type Contract
Job function Job function Accounting/Auditing

\\nCompany Description

Lisa Giannone, Active Care founder, has developed and masterminded an approach on treating orthopedic and sports injury that has been highly successful. Her system involves a point of view in analysis, the development of a working theory for each individual patient case, and an understanding of mechanics and the kinetic chain and its influence on the recovery path. In her system, each step of the rehab process must be supported by a "why" that both the patient and therapist understand. This is not cookie-cutter or textbook as Lisa's theories and practices developed out of her academic background in biochemistry, physiology, and biomechanics and through the more than 30 years of experience she has in the field. The vast majority of the techniques and exercises used to manage AC patients were developed and nuanced by Lisa and make up her system of care and training. All practitioners of AC are trained to practice within this system and learn directly from Lisa. She guides her team from her belief that "Exercise is the Medicine", "that it is only through methodical mechanical work to the body both manually and through proprietary exercise series that real and lasting, durable recovery can be accomplished in orthopedic and sports injury." We have been in practice for more than 30 years keeping athletes and athletically ambitious patients moving forward.

### Job Description

Job Description

**Benefits:**

- Health insurance
- Opportunity for advancement
- Paid time off
- Training & development
- 401(k)
- Competitive salary
- Employee discounts
- Paid holidays

**Location:** Bay Area, CA (Must understand local travel/traffic considerations) **Position Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented **Sales & Project Coordinator** to partner directly with our Account Management team. The goal of this role is to maximize our sales capacity by taking ownership of critical administrative, estimating, and project-processing workflows.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant position; you will act as the engine behind our sales pipeline, ensuring projects move efficiently from initial site survey to final delivery while allowing our sales team to focus on client relationships and closing business.

**Core Responsibilities**

- **Survey & Project Processing:** Organize and process site survey notes, compile photos and measurements, and prepare comprehensive project information for quoting.
- **Estimating & System Support:** Build estimate drafts, enter products and line items, and assist with formal quote preparation within our **CoreBridge POS** management system.
- **Design & File Support:** Use Adobe Illustrator to scale and review files, verify measurements/specifications, and package accurate information for our design team.
- **Standards & Compliance:** Learn and maintain key client sign standards for major accounts to ensure project consistency and pre-production compliance.
- **Vendor & Subcontractor Coordination:** Request pricing from vendors, proactively follow up on outstanding quotes, and coordinate seamless communication with subcontractors.
- **Scheduling & Logistics:** Manage the account manager’s calendar, schedule appointments, and coordinate surveys with an understanding of Bay Area traffic and travel logistics.
- **Project Tracking:** Maintain project task lists, identify immediate next steps, follow up on outstanding action items, and help push projects through the pipeline.

**Desired Skills & Qualifications**

- **Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented:** You take pride in precision and don't let small details slip through the cracks.
- **Strong Communicator:** Comfortable and professional when making phone calls and sending emails to clients, vendors, and team members.
- **Tech Savvy:** Familiar with **Google Workspace** and capable of quickly learning proprietary industry software like **CoreBridge** .
- **Design Tool Familiarity:** Experience or familiarity with **Adobe Illustrator** is mandatory.
- **Problem Solver:** A self-starter who can independently identify bottlenecks and solve problems without waiting for instructions.
- **Adaptable Learner:** Willing and eager to learn industry-specific terminology and technical sign standards.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

When you succeed, the whole team succeeds. In this role, your impact will be felt immediately through:

- Faster quote turnaround times and more consistent client follow-up.
- Highly organized, accurate project files that keep complex jobs moving forward efficiently.
- Reduced bottlenecks and stress across the production pipeline.
- Increased sales capacity, allowing the account team to drive revenue and scale business.

### Job Description

Job Description

**avfleet.ai** runs an electric fleet for rideshare and last-mile delivery in San Francisco. When a shift is live, the Operations Coordinator is the person drivers turn to — the one who runs the huddle, answers the radio, shows up when something goes wrong, and makes sure the shift is recorded right.

**What you’ll do**

- Run the pre-shift huddle. Get your drivers aligned on safety, shift priorities, latest company communications, and confirm everyone’s ready to roll


- Coach in the moment. Watch how your drivers are doing, give them useful feedback while it still matters, and flag patterns to your Supervisor


- Be the two-way radio. Carry direction from your Supervisor to your drivers, and carry your drivers’ concerns back up. Both directions matter equally


- Solve problems live. Trip issues, collisions, a van that won’t charge — you coordinate the response with appropriate parties and stay with it until it’s handled


- Keep the record straight. Attendance, tardiness, shift start and end, exceptions. Accurate records protect your drivers and your operation


- Get vehicles ready. Work with maintenance, charging, and fleet so cars are charged, clean, and assigned before drivers shows up


- Watch the board. Live maps, safety alerts and dashboards all shift, so you catch the flags before they become problems


**What you bring**

- A year or more in dispatch, coordination, team lead, or a customer-facing role — transportation, logistics, delivery, hospitality, call center, or field ops all count. Or equivalent experience


- You’re comfortable with live maps, dashboards, and apps, and you pick up new tools fast


- You can run a room of drivers at huddle and can keep composure during difficult coaching sessions and driver conflicts. De-escalation skills are key


- Detail discipline. The shift records must be right


- Availability for full-time evening and/or overnight shifts, including weekends


- A valid California driver’s license and ability to meet our insurance standards — you’ll occasionally drive a company vehicle to reach a driver at an incident or move cars in the lot


No degree required

**Nice to have**

- You’ve driven for Uber or Lyft


- You’ve coordinated or led an hourly team before


- Familiarity with EVs, charging, or fleet operations


- You know San Francisco geography and traffic patterns


- Able to speak Spanish


**What it pays**

$22.00 – $24.00 per hour. This is the good-faith range we reasonably expect to pay on hire; where you land depends on your experience and internal equity.

Predictable hours. We schedule 8-hour shifts, 5 days a week and we staff to end on time. Overtime is occasional rather than routine — when it happens, it’s paid at time and a half past 8 hours in a day or 40 in a week.

We also offer medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, and California paid sick leave.

**The environment**

You’ll move between the office and an active vehicle yard through your shift, stand for huddles, occasionally lift up to 40 pounds, and work evenings, overnights, and weekends. Need a reasonable accommodation to do any part of this job? Tell us and we’ll work it out with you.

**How to apply**

We read every application ourselves — no automated screening, no resume-ranking software.

Fast-growing technology company

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

##### The Role

Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Act as a broad generalist who takes initiatives from first launch through scale, spanning business development, client engagement and delivery operations. The work involves frequent interaction with senior stakeholders and coordination of outside specialists, with a path toward owning key accounts over time.

##### What You'll Do

- Drive go-to-market and outbound efforts, including rolling out engagements across multiple organizations.
- Build executive-level presentations and prepare materials and questions for employee shadowing sessions.
- Run operations that convert client data into structured work products, including quality review and removal of personal information.
- Recruit and coordinate small groups of subject-matter experts.
- Manage the schedule, quality and cost of delivery to customers.
- Partner with an engineer to co-own key accounts, specializing over time in one side of the business.

##### What We're Looking For

- A degree from a top university.
- Track record of leading projects or workstreams at a leading consulting firm, investment bank or early-stage startup.
- Client-facing experience with senior or executive stakeholders, such as preparing decks, running discovery or pitching.
- Comfort turning numbers into practical decisions about resourcing and delivery.
- Background running training or evaluation programs for AI systems.
- 0 to 4 years of relevant experience.

##### Bonus Points

- Experience managing distributed teams.
- Experience working with enterprise data.
- Startup go-to-market or outbound experience.

##### Benefits

- Health, dental and vision coverage

##### Location And Work Model

- San Francisco Bay Area, CA, United States
- On-site, 5 days per week in office
- Full-time

##### Compensation, As The Posting Describes It

- Equity
- Commission

# Police Dispatcher Trainee

Coliseum Station

[Oakland, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Oakland%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1934990818390817955?p=1&pos=0&rgn=5907&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3549481470576088023&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Police Dispatcher Trainee

Ride BART to a satisfying career that lets you both: 1) make a difference to Bay Area residents, and 2) enjoy excellent pay, benefits, and employment stability. BART is looking for people who like to be challenged, work in a fast-paced environment, and have a passion for connecting riders to work, school and other places they need to go. BART offers a competitive salary, comprehensive health benefits, paid time off, and the CalPERS retirement program.

The San Francisco Bay Area Rapid Transit District (BART) Police Department is seeking highly motivated, service-oriented individuals to begin a career in public safety communications as a Police Dispatcher Trainee. This entry-level training classification provides candidates with the opportunity to develop the knowledge, technical skills, judgment, and confidence necessary to support police operations within one of the nation's largest and most dynamic public transit systems.

Working under close supervision as part of a formal training program, Police Dispatcher Trainees learn to receive, evaluate, prioritize, and transmit emergency and non-emergency calls for police services. Trainees receive hands-on instruction and guided experience in departmental procedures, radio protocols, applicable laws, codes and regulations, computer-aided dispatch (CAD), telecommunications systems, emergency communications, and police radio operations. This position is well suited for individuals who can remain composed in high-pressure situations, process information quickly and accurately, communicate clearly, and successfully manage multiple priorities at the same time.

The ideal candidate is a motivated and adaptable learner who can quickly absorb, retain, and apply complex information, including radio protocols, dispatch procedures, law enforcement terminology, CAD systems, and telecommunications technology. They are receptive to training and feedback, committed to continuous improvement, and demonstrate increasing confidence, independence, and proficiency as they progress through the training program.

The most qualified candidates for this position will have highly developed competencies in the following areas, which will be reinforced with related work experience and will be clearly articulated during the selection process:

- Communication and Active Listening – Communicates clearly and professionally while listening carefully, asking appropriate questions, and gathering essential information.
- Composure and Stress Tolerance – Maintains focus, professionalism, and emotional control in high-pressure or emergency situations.
- Multitasking and Prioritization – Manages multiple tasks and information sources simultaneously while prioritizing effectively and maintaining accuracy.
- Critical Thinking and Sound Judgment – Quickly evaluates information, identifies priorities, and makes appropriate decisions within established procedures.
- Attention to Detail and Accuracy – Accurately receives, records, and communicates critical information that may affect public and officer safety.
- Teamwork and Collaboration – Works effectively with colleagues and agency partners while remaining receptive to coaching, feedback, and development.
- Public Service and Interpersonal Effectiveness – Provides professional, respectful, and responsive service to individuals from diverse backgrounds.
- Adaptability and Reliability – Adapts to changing priorities and emergency conditions while demonstrating consistent dependability in a 24-hour public safety environment.

The selection process for this position will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement and may include one or more of the following: a skills or performance demonstration, written examination, and/or panel or individual interview.

All applications will be reviewed by the Talent Acquisition Division to determine whether applicants meet the established Minimum Qualifications (MQs). Applicants who meet the MQs may be referred to the hiring department for further evaluation as part of the selection process. Unsuccessful applicants may re-apply online by visiting our website at for a listing of open positions.

The selection process for the Police Dispatcher Trainee will include 6 phases:

PHASE 1: Background Pre-Screening Application Questionnaire

PHASE 2: Minimum Qualifications Screening

PHASE 3: POST Entry-Level Dispatcher Selection Test Battery written examination.

Applicants may be waived from the written exam if they possess one of the following:

- Have a POST Entry-Level Dispatcher Selection Test Battery (T-Score) of 48 or higher dated within the last 12 months
- Have passing CritiCall scores dated within the last 12 months
- Have a valid POST Dispatcher Academy Certificate and/or POST Dispatcher Certificate

PHASE 4: Typing Test (or typing certificate submission)

Typing Certificate Requirements:

• 5- minute timed test • Must be able to type at a speed of 40 net words per minute • Certificate must include gross and net words per minute with no more than 10 errors • Typing certificates must be within the last six (6) months by a recognized college, public school, career center or temporary employment agency.

Note: Current BART employees who are occupying positions which presently require a 40 Net WPM typing requirement will be exempt from meeting the typing certificate requirement for the Police Dispatcher Trainee program.

PHASE 5: Oral Board Interview

PHASE 6: Background investigation. (may include polygraph, psychological screening)

Please note that the entire selection process may take 4-6 months to complete. The selected candidate must demonstrate a work history reflecting reliability and dependability and may be required to provide copies of certificates, diplomas, or other documentation required by law, including proof of authorization to work in the United States, and pass a pre-employment medical examination, which is specific to the essential job functions and requirements. Pre-employment processing will also include an extensive background check, a credit check, and successful completion of a polygraph exam. We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. # CRM Marketing Manager

The Fountain Group

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2964742095613236304?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-448213192152848047&crId=US_0US_0)

Seeking Marketing Manager II to join our team supporting DoorDash for Business . In this role, you will design and execute retention and lifecycle marketing programs that increase adoption and activation of benefits across our Enterprise partners and their employees (B2B2C).
You will leverage CRM channels (email, push, SMS, in-app messaging) to drive engagement, create scalable personalized experiences, and optimize the welcome and onboarding journey. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment , enjoys working with cross-functional partners, and brings expertise in retention marketing, CRM tools, and campaign analytics.
What You’ll Do Develop and execute CRM and retention strategies to increase adoption and engagement across Enterprise partners and their employees.

Create and optimize email marketing programs , including segmentation, targeting, and personalization.

Build scalable lifecycle programs that personalize communications to company administrators and employee users based on available benefits.

Manage campaigns end-to-end: creative reviews, cross-functional collaboration, campaign operations, stakeholder alignment, and post-campaign analysis.

Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics, and Strategy teams to align CRM initiatives with business goals.

Analyze campaign performance, conduct A/B and multivariate tests , and provide actionable insights and recommendations.

Share regular performance reports and benchmarks with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement.

Qualifications 3+ years’ experience in Retention Marketing, Email Marketing, Customer Engagement, or CRM Operations.

B2B2C marketing experience strongly preferred; B2B/SaaS experience a plus.

Proficiency with CRM and ESP platforms (Iterable and Braze preferred), including segmentation and audience targeting.

Experience working with complex data structures and systems to drive campaign execution.

Strong knowledge of campaign analytics and experimentation (A/B testing, multivariate testing, Excel/Google Sheets).

Proven stakeholder management and communication skills ; able to present results and recommendations to cross-functional teams.

Highly organized, self-motivated, dependable, and able to manage multiple priorities.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

# Office Manager - a Culture & Experience Specialist

We-Are-Social

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3827638898711878452?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8178572826969137522&crId=US_0US_0)

Chronically online? Weirdly organized? Obsessed with making things better? You might be our person!

We’re looking for an Office Manager to bring energy, organization, creativity, and good vibes to our LA office. You’ll be the person who makes the office run smoothly — and makes people actually want to be here.

Think: part culture-maker, part problem-solver, part host, part behind-the-scenes MVP. You’ll create memorable office experiences, keep the day-to-day moving, support our team and leadership, and find smart ways to use AI and new tech to make work easier. Did we just say AI? We’re looking for someone with a genuine curiosity about how technology (vibe coding anyone?) can change the way we work. This isn’t just an office operations role. We want someone who will look at the way we do things and think, “There has to be a smarter way.” Then go figure it out.

No agency experience? No problem. If you’re social-savvy, curious about what’s next, great with people, and excited to break into the agency world, we want to meet you.

## WE ARE

A creative agency powered by social connections. That means we thrive on what’s trending and create campaigns that get people buzzing. We call it “Ideas Worth Talking About,” and we’re proud to have played a part in some of the most culturally relevant campaigns of the decade for brands like McDonald’s, Adidas, Universal Studios, and YouTube.

## WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE

We like to laugh, live for celeb gossip, and we’re great on AUX.

Our passport program lets you explore and work from one of our 16 other offices worldwide, including Paris, Singapore, Madrid, Dubai, London, and more.

We know how to celebrate our wins — and our losses. It’s how we learn.

From carbon offsets to community kitchens, we’re passionate about making a difference.

Did we say snacks? Because we have great snacks.

## YOU ARE

Socially savvy. You know what’s trending, what’s over, and what’s about to blow up.

A people person. You naturally make everyone feel welcome — from the CEO to the person dropping off lunch.

Manage budgets and keep an eye on office-related spending.

Oversee shared meeting room scheduling and the internal out-of-office calendar.

Partner with our Social Committee to create experiences that bring people together.

Experiment with AI tools, prompting, automation, and low-code/vibe-coding to create clever shortcuts and solutions.

Bring curiosity and a “what if we tried this?” mindset to everyday operations.

Excellent communication skills.

Curiosity about social media, internet culture, pop culture, and emerging trends.

Calm, tactful, and professional under pressure.

Discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential information.

We invite you to review our current business services professionals openings to learn about the opportunities available across the firm.

**About Us**

Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP has forged a reputation as one of the most prestigious law firms in the world. Relying on innovation, intellect, teamwork and tenacity, our lawyers deliver the highest quality advice and novel solutions to our clients' legal issues. We are known for handling the most complex transactions, litigation/controversy issues, and regulatory matters, as well as for the strong partnerships we build with clients and each other. Our attorneys, who reflect a broad range of experiences and perspectives, work together seamlessly across 50-plus practices and 21 offices in the world's major financial centers.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an **Administrative Coordinator** to join our Firm. This position will be based in our Los Angeles office (on-site/hybrid). The Administrative Coordinator provides coordination and administrative support for the day-to-day operations of Paralegal Services, Administrative Support, and Professional Support Services for the Los Angeles office. Assists with departmental projects, workflow coordination, and other administrative activities, while collaborating with team members and other Firm departments. Serves as a resource to department personnel by responding to routine questions regarding department procedures and providing high-quality customer service. - Assists with scheduling and calendar management for team meetings, training programs, events and department-wide meetings across the attorney support departments.

- Coordinates with Conference Services for meeting and training requests, including but not limited to audio-visual and catering services.
- Monitors shared department inboxes, email requests, and assignments, helping to ensure timely responses.
- Reviews time on a weekly basis to ensure compliance with daily entry requirements.
- Assists with administrative responsibilities, including monitoring and approving time and attendance records, absence requests, and overtime, while helping to ensure accuracy and compliance with Firm policies.
- Maintains department spreadsheets, trackers, and databases related to staffing, workflow, attendance, coverage, overtime, and other operational metrics.
- Processes invoices, check requests, and expense reports by confirming the accuracy of the reports and ensuring that supporting documentation is attached prior to forwarding the documents for signature.
- Develops project strategies to ensure efficient completion of tasks.
- Escalates employee relations concerns, staffing issues, or operational problems to the Senior Manager as appropriate.
- Consults with the Firm's business services departments and internal employees at all levels.
- Coordinates with other Firm offices both domestically and internationally as required.
- Assists with Department initiatives and special projects.
- Assures that all completed projects adhere to accepted professional standards.
- Organizes and facilitates conference and video calls.
- Performs assignments that are varied and complex in nature, often while under time critical deadlines.
- Demonstrates effective interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills to facilitate effective work relationships with others.
- Manages Firm resources responsibly.
- Regular and reliable physical presence.
- Complies with and understands Firm operations, policies and procedures.
- Performs other related duties, as assigned.

- Ability to provide upper-margin customer service
- Demonstrates high proficiency with relevant Firm computer software programs( e.g., Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint), with the ability to learn new software and operating systems
- Ability to navigate various electronic databases and document repositories
- Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, organizational and planning skills
- Demonstrates a high level of professionalism
- Flexibility and willingness to perform a wide range of tasks extending beyond routine expectations
- Demonstrates the initiative and confidence to assume a high level of responsibility in a fast-paced environment
- Demonstrates effective interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and in writing
- Ability to handle sensitive matters and maintain confidentiality
- Ability to read, interpret, convey, and follow instructions
- Demonstrates close attention to detail
- Ability to organize and prioritize work
- Ability to work well independently, as well as effectively, within a team
- Ability to handle multiple projects, assignments, and shifting responsibilities and deadlines
- Ability to assume progressive responsibilities within assigned work as experience is gained in the position
- Ability to work well under pressure
- Strong organizational skills
- Ability to work well in a demanding and fast-paced environment
- Flexibility to adjust hours and work the hours necessary to meet operating and business needs

**Education and Experience**

- Bachelor's degree
- Minimum of two years' related experience in a law firm or professional services environment

We believe in teamwork and inspiring each other to be our best in an atmosphere that promotes professionalism and excellence in all that we do. We know that inclusion and drawing on the strength of a wide spectrum of talent only make us better and is vital to the firm's success. Our goal is for everyone at the firm to enjoy a challenging career with opportunities for development and growth and to support the well-being of our attorneys and business services professionals.

- Comprehensive health care (medical, dental, vision), savings plan/401(k) and voluntary benefits.
- Generous paid time off.
- Paid leave options, including parental.
- In-classroom, remote, and on-demand learning and professional development opportunities.
- Robust well-being classes and programs.
- Opportunities to give back and make an impact in local communities.

This is an individual contributor role where one will work within a team environment comprised of Program Management, Finance, Technical and other supporting staff. The Sr. Program Scheduler successfully integrates resources, task status and risk management in the schedule. This position can be in anywhere in the west coast such as San Diego, CA, Simi Valley, CA or Petaluma, CA. Position is hybrid where you will come in as needed.
Position Responsibilities
Maintains schedule integrity including, but not limited to, proper schedule structure and cost alignment (MIL-STD-881 or similar program hierarchy) with proper network logic producing a realistic program critical path. Adherence to FAR & EVMS principles a plus
Maintenance of the IMS, summary and detail schedules (vertical schedule integration), support project status meetings, maintain schedule metrics and performance reports, identify and track project risk activities, perform critical path analysis & support reporting of program performance against the plan
Schedules configuration control, change management and schedule baseline control
Risk planning with program/project management using the schedule for identifying and recommending mitigation strategies for project risks to ensure cost & Schedule targets are achieved

Experienced using Schedule Health Analysis and Schedule Risk Assessment tools
Demonstrated knowledge of planning and scheduling processes with IMP/IMS methodologies, EVM and Program Management metrics and reporting
Current expertise in: 1) MS Office Suite (Advanced MS Excel required), 2) MS Project

Experience developing Work Breakdown Structures, utilizing cost-schedule baseline change controls and integrating cost and scheduling tools (Cobra & Pro Pricer for EVMS & Proposals, respectively) is desired

### Job Description

Job Description

**Job Title:** Scheduler II/III

**Location:** Public Works Headquarters Building located at 900 S. Fremont Avenue, Alhambra, CA

**Pay Range:** Scheduler II: $140-$160k/year // Scheduler III: $160-180k/year plus benefits

**Client:** County of Los Angeles Department of Public Works

**Project Name:** Rebuild Authority Program

**Project Duration:** Long-term, full-time assignment; duration subject to County funding and ongoing project needs

**Anticipated Start Date:** November/December 2026

**Project Details (Size, SOW, Site Background, etc.):**

Public Works, Rebuild Authority, is seeking an experienced Scheduler II/III to develop, maintain, and report on schedules for a portfolio of recovery and rebuild capital projects. The anticipated rough order magnitude value of the collective projects is approximately $800 million.

**Work Schedule:**

This role follows will follow a 5/40 hybrid schedule, with up to 2 days remote.

**Required Qualifications (Experience, Education, Certifications, Clearances, etc.):**

- Minimum 10 years (Scheduler II) or 15 years (Scheduler III) of project scheduling experience on public capital or construction projects, including at least 5 years of experience in planning and scheduling projects from design through construction and close-out
- Advanced proficiency in scheduling software, inclusive of Primavera and Microsoft Project
- Education background in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field
- Ability to develop critical path method (CPM) baseline schedules and maintain them through regular updates
- Ability to build and maintain an integrated master program schedule across multiple concurrent projects

This position is responsible for planning, scheduling, coordinating, and monitoring the flow of products through the complete production cycle. They provide timely planning and scheduling of batches to achieve both internal financial goals and customer requirements. This position is responsible for scheduling and transferring the material to distribution centers when required & controls inventory levels in various distribution centers.

**Additional Information:**

40 hours a week - Flexibility required to support a 24/7 environment

This position is also eligible for bonus based on performance and subject to the terms of the Company's applicable plans.

Job duties include contact with other employees and access to confidential and proprietary information and/or other items of value, and such access may be supervised or unsupervised. The Company therefore has determined that a review of criminal history is necessary to protect the business and its operations and reputation and is necessary to protect the safety of the Company's staff, employees, and business relationships.

The selected internal candidate may qualify for the GSC Relocation Adjustment Program. Please click this link for more details.

- Schedule production at the facility
- Adjust production schedule to accommodate emergency situations
- Review exception reports to ensure customer service defined by division goals
- Monitor product availability, order completeness, inventory deployment, transportation costs
- Issue batch tickets to blending and production floor
- Research and report on any issues regarding batch ticket questions or concerns
- Update pull boards to meet customer requirements
- Order raw materials and packaging components
- Maintain systems to ensure accurate information and timely production of product to meet customer service goals
- Expedite order changes as needed, such as requirement or delivery date changes
- Maintain accurate records of purchases through system and supply requisites
- Review acknowledgements of purchase order daily for any discrepancies
- Initiate and maintain effective and professional relationships with suppliers
- Review MRP (Material Resource Planning) daily for unusual production to determine inventory quantities and levels

**Minimum Requirements:**

- Must be at least eighteen (18) years of age
- Must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment without needing sponsorship for employment work visa status now or in the future
- Must have a bachelor's degree or higher or have at least four (4) years of work experience in a Purchasing, Logistics, Supply Chain, or Operations role
- Must have at least one (1) year of work experience in a Purchasing, Logistics, Supply Chain, or Operations role or have completed a Sherwin-Williams Development Program in an operations or supply chain function

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Have a bachelor's degree or higher in Materials Management, Supply Chain, Logistics or Business
- Have completed formal training in and/or have at least one (1) year of work experience applying continuous improvement tools such as Six Sigma, 5-S, Lean Manufacturing, Transactional Lean, etc.
- Have prior work experience using MRP (Material Resource Planning) and MPS (Material Production Scheduling) systems
- Have prior work experience in procurement, buying, and/or scheduling
- Have at least one (1) year of experience working in a manufacturing and/or distribution facility
- Prior work experience using planning software such as QAD, Oracle, or SAP

# Administrative Assistant / Property Management Assistant Bilingual

Skyone Group LLC

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2304811101805782197?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=306&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-439990119166853099&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

We are a Southern California real estate investment and property management firm seeking a **bilingual Administrative Assistant / Property Management Assistant** to support our Property Manager and assist with the day-to-day operations of our portfolio.

This is a **full-time, in-office position in Los Angeles** and is ideal for someone who is organized, dependable, professional, and interested in building a long-term career in property management. The ideal candidate is fluent in both **English and Spanish** , comfortable communicating with tenants and vendors, detail-oriented with administrative tasks, and preferably has experience with **Rent Manager** or similar property management software.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Answer and route incoming phone calls in a professional and courteous manner
- Communicate with tenants, vendors, and residents in both English and Spanish
- Assist with rent entry, lease data entry, and maintaining accurate tenant records
- Take maintenance calls and create work orders
- Collect, scan, upload, and organize lease files, notices, insurance certificates, and tenant correspondence
- Maintain rent rolls, tenant contact lists, and unit/suite availability trackers
- Support the Property Manager with administrative and operational tasks
- Enter and update information in property management software, preferably Rent Manager
- Help track leases, notices, tenant communications, and property files
- Schedule appointments, inspections, vendor meetings, and property visits
- Assist with general office duties and follow-up tasks
- Provide support with basic property management coordination as needed

**Qualifications**

- Fluent in English and Spanish, both written and spoken
- 1–3 years of administrative, office, receptionist, or property management support experience
- Prior experience in property management, real estate, construction, or a related field preferred
- Experience with Rent Manager preferred; experience with Yardi, AppFolio, or similar software is a plus
- Comfortable with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, and PDF/document management
- Experience handling tenant calls, collections calls, or maintenance coordination is a plus
- Experience with data entry and recordkeeping in a fast-paced office
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Professional phone manner and strong communication skills
- Ability to multitask and work well in a team environment

**Preferred Traits**

- Highly organized and process-oriented
- Team player, but able to work independently
- Dependable and punctual
- Comfortable switching between administrative work and tenant-facing work
- Reliable, proactive, and responsive
- Strong follow-through and willingness to take initiative

Job Summary

Everyone at the Good Seed has a superpower. This new member of the Good Seed team would be supporting the achievement of our noble mission: Helping youth grow and thrive! The Administrative Assistant will contribute to this mission by providing support for, and participating in, key processes and programs that sustain the purpose and overall goal of the organization. This person will work with the Executive Director and other Good Seed staff to ensure that all administrative and facility needs are met through the provision of high-level administrative work.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Provide administrative support, in whichever areas are needed.
- Coordinate and execute special projects and initiatives as directed.
- Ensure that office operations run smoothly, including maintaining adequate office supply replenishment; equipment maintenance; liaising with vendors to facilitate building maintenance; courier services; etc.

- Create and maintain accurate administrative procedure manuals to ensure efficient operations.
- Organize, maintain, and periodically audit The Good Seed filing system (both hard copy and electronic).
- Recommend opportunities for increased efficiency and process improvements.
- Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications and Skills Requirements**

- Strong computer skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Excellent organizational skills.
- Strong data entry and analytical skills.
- Ability to effectively prioritize and meet deadlines for a wide variety of assignments.
- Experience working with and maintaining highly sensitive and confidential information.
- Flexible.
- Ability to operate standard office equipment and troubleshoot issues.
- Efficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
- Sound judgment and decision-making ability.
- High School Diploma (required).
- 3+ years experience in an office environment.
- **Ability to lift 25lbs.**

Live Nation Entertainment

Job Summary:

**WHO ARE WE?**

Live Nation Entertainment is the world's leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit

**WHO ARE YOU?**

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

**THE ROLE**

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable **Administrative Assistant, Legal,** to provide support to the Head of Business, Legal Affairs, Strategy and Operations. This is an important role for someone who wants to learn at a fast-paced, international music-based company that's rapidly growing its film & TV business.

The ideal candidate is a proactive professional with strong communication skills and the ability to manage multiple high priorities simultaneously with accuracy to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Legal experience is not required-we are looking for someone with strong skin, strong professional experience, and strong interpersonal skills. An interest in music, movies, television, and the entertainment industry is a plus. A love of spreadsheets is a plus-plus.

**WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO**

- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Head of Business, Legal Affairs, Strategy and Operations.
- Maintain well-organized electronic files, records, and documents.
- Prepare, format, proofread, edit, and organize correspondence, agreements, reports, and other documents.
- Manage calendars, meetings, appointments, and deadlines.
- Track important dates, deliverables, follow-ups, and outstanding items.
- Coordinate meetings, conference calls, zooms and other internal and external communications.
- Assist with document management, including scanning, filing, copying, naming, and organizing documents.
- Enter, update, and maintain information in databases, spreadsheets, and other systems.
- Communicate professionally with colleagues, vendors, and outside parties.
- Monitor incoming and outgoing correspondence and ensure timely follow-up.
- Help coordinate signatures, approvals, and other administrative processes.
- Handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
- Assist with expense reports, invoices, time records, and other administrative matters as needed.
- Anticipate needs and proactively address issues before they become problems.
- Perform general administrative and office support duties as needed.

**WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING**

**Required Qualifications**

- Minimum of 2 years of prior professional work experience in an administrative, assistant, office, business, creative, legal, or similar professional role.
- Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook, Excel, Adobe, and PowerPoint
- Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, and Google Sheets
- Strong file-management skills, including maintaining organized digital folders and consistent file naming
- Ability to use spreadsheets for basic data entry, tracking, and organization
- Comfortable learning and working with databases, document-management systems, cloud-based software, and other business applications
- Strong ability to prioritize, manage, and problem-solve multiple tasks, projects, and deadlines
- Strong follow-through and accountability
- Ability to learn new software, systems, procedures, and terminology quickly

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience supporting attorneys, executives, managers, agents, producers, or other entertainment industry professionals is a plus
- Experience working in a law firm, entertainment company, production company, music business, agency, management company, or other creative-industry environment
- Familiarity with legal documents, contracts, or basic legal terminology
- Experience working with confidential or sensitive information
- Experience managing multiple calendars, projects, or competing deadlines

**BENEFITS & PERKS**

Our motto is 'Taking Care of Our Own' through 6 pillars of benefits:

- **HEALTH** **:** Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
- **YOURSELF** **:** Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
- **WEALTH** **:** 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
- **FAMILY** **:** New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
- **CAREER** **:** Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
- **OTHERS** **:** Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Dilanchian Chiropractic is looking for an experienced, motivated, and bilingual individual to join our busy and fast-paced chiropractic clinics in Koreatown & Granada Hills, Los Angeles, California!

We’re seeking someone who is friendly, organized, dependable, and passionate about providing an exceptional patient experience. If you’re a team player who can multitask while maintaining a warm and professional attitude, we’d love to meet you!

WE'RE HIRING: Part-Time & Full-Time Administrative Assistant / Front Desk
What You’ll Do

Warmly greet patients and create a welcoming front-desk experience

Manage check-in and intake for new and existing patients

Answer and manage phone calls, emails, and patient inquiries

Schedule and coordinate patient appointments

Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records

Track patient treatment plans and recommendations

Maintain patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA requirements

Answer patient questions and address concerns professionally

Coordinate with chiropractors, therapists, and back-office staff

Keep the reception area organized, clean, and welcoming

Assist with office supplies and general administrative tasks

Support the team with day-to-day clinic operations

Bilingual preferred

Previous front desk, administrative, healthcare, or chiropractic office experience preferred

Excellent communication and customer service skills

Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

Positive, professional, and friendly attitude

Reliable and punctual

Comfortable working in a busy, fast-paced environment

Ability to work independently while being a strong team player

Professional appearance and demeanor

Work Location: In Person

Paid Time Off

Fabricast Inc

[South El Monte, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/South-El-Monte%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2211881206959022423?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6633&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2815424341804665506&crId=US_0US_0)

Description
This is a part time to begin but may grow into a full-time position.

## POSITION SUMMARY:

The Administrative Assistant is responsible for completion of administrative functions to ensure efficient day-to-day operations across all departments. This role supports leadership through office organization, employee communications, banking, shipping, quoting, accounting, production scheduling, purchasing, recordkeeping, and facility coordination. The Administrative Assistant also plays a key role in ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.

This position requires strong organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

## REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS:

This position reports directly to the Operations Manager. No positions report directly to this position.

## REQUIREMENTS:

EDUCATION - Relevant experience is required.

SKILLS - Strong customer service, listening, written and oral communication skills are essential to effectively collect and disseminate information with callers, visitors, customers and employees at all levels of the organization. Strong computer, typing and successful multi-tasking ability is necessary. Professionalism, time management, organization, and prioritization skills are critical competencies. Must be able to successfully work under time and budgetary pressures.

PHYSICAL - Regularly required to sit, walk, talk, stand, bend and hear (with mechanical assistance if necessary), possess specific vision abilities including near vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus to perform the essential requirements of the position.

MENTAL - Must be able to read, write and speak English fluently and possess the ability to communicate clear on technical and business levels while maintaining professional conduct is essential.

## WORKING CONDITIONS:

The Administrative Assistant will primarily work in a plant office setting which is a temperature controlled, smoke free environment with occasional exposure to typical factory hazards including noise, dust, and tripping hazards. Fabricast functions in a real market environment that changes at various times of the year which occasionally may create high output or greater time pressure demands.

This position is a PART TIME ROLE, maintaining a 20 hour per week working expectation. Fabricast currently works a four day work week on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays. Hours of operation are 530AM to 4PM. This role will be present 5hrs per day on each of those days.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES, RESPONSIBILITIES, AND MEASUREMENTS OF PERFORMANCE:

Follow rules and processes as outlined in the Employee Handbook, Quality Manual, and Safety training regarding conduct and performance standards expected of all employees

Demonstrate collaborative working relationships, good judgment, reasoning, and professional conduct in all business interactions, representing Fabricast favorably with employees, customers, and vendors.

Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor appropriate for the position and situation

Maintain a positive work attitude that reflects the Fabricast Core Values (Care, Hardworking/ Dedicated, Creative Problem Solver, accountability, and Knowledge Seeker)

Generate production travelers, complete purchase orders for direct materials, generate timecards/job cards, manage accounts payable/receivable, manage banking transactions, generate quote drafts, manage day-to-day office operations, supplies, and vendor relationships.

Support leadership with meeting coordination, document preparation, and communication tracking.

Maintain company directories, phone lists, and communication boards.

Assist with coordination of company events, training, and employee recognition programs.

Manage data entry related to business operations, reporting, and invoice processing.

Serve as primary contact for incoming office inquiries and external correspondence.

Ensure compliance with company policies, safety requirements, and quality documentation procedures.

Provide back-up support to other administrative functions as needed.
